Title_en: Algorithmic design failure
Definition_en: The risk that algorithms, architectures, or optimisation methods unsuited to a robot's control cycle, sensor latency, contact dynamics, or real-time compute constraints degrade physical-system safety and performance.

Title_en: Ambiguous high-level safety instruction
Definition_en: The risk that a high-level safety instruction does not specify how to resolve a concrete conflict among user intent, physical hazard, and operational constraints, allowing inconsistent robot actions.

Title_ko: 제어 판단·제어권 전환 실패에 따른 자율주행 충돌
Title_en: Automated driving crash risk from control and handoff failures
Definition_en: The risk that an AI-based automated driving system makes unsafe control decisions because of perception, planning, or software failures or edge cases, or transfers control authority ambiguously or too late in time-critical events, leaving neither the human nor the system able to take the safety action needed to avoid a collision.

Title_en: Command exceeds embodiment-specific hardware limits
Definition_en: The risk that a model issues a command that exceeds the known reach, payload, actuator, joint, or end-effector limits of the robot on which it is deployed.

Title_ko: 통신 단절 및 제어 링크 손실
Title_en: Communication dropout and control-link loss
Definition_en: The risk that a robot or vehicle loses command, telemetry, or control-link connectivity, causing an unsafe stop, execution of stale commands, or uncontrolled motion.

Title_ko: 피지컬 AI 시스템 설계 단계 명세 오류
Title_en: Design-stage specification errors
Definition_en: The risk that pre-deployment design errors in a robot, humanoid, or physical AI system, including code defects, disproportionate objective weights, or goals misaligned with human values, cause system behaviour to depart from intended formal properties.

Title_en: Distribution shift in physical operating environments
Definition_en: The risk that physical operating environments across buildings, roads, factories, homes, hospitals, or weather conditions change faster than a robot, humanoid, or physical AI control policy can detect and adapt, degrading path planning, motion control, or actuation and causing unsafe physical actions.

Title_ko: 원자력 및 핵심 인프라에 대한 AI 제어 오류
Title_en: Erroneous AI control of nuclear and critical infrastructure systems
Definition_en: The risk that AI deployed to monitor, optimise, or automate nuclear facilities, radioactive material handling, power grids, water treatment, telecommunications, or transport misreads sensor data and fails to recognise critical safety conditions or cascading failure modes. The resulting control decisions cause radiation release, containment failure, widespread outages, and collapse of essential services.

Title_en: Excessive end-effector velocity
Definition_en: The risk that a robot exceeds safe end-effector speed limits near humans or fragile objects, increasing impact and collision severity.

Title_en: Failure to reject hazardous instructions
Definition_en: The risk that an embodied AI agent fails to identify and reject an instruction involving a physical hazard, whether the hazard is explicit or implicit in an otherwise ordinary task request, and proceeds to execute an unsafe action.

Title_ko: 물리적 위험에 대한 적시 대응 실패
Title_en: Failure to respond promptly to physical hazards
Definition_en: The risk that a robot, humanoid, or physical AI system fails to intervene, reject a hazardous action, or update its motion plan promptly in a hazardous physical situation, including when a person, vehicle, tool, or object unexpectedly enters its path, causing collision or injury.

Title_en: Fine motor control instability
Definition_en: The risk that small control errors in dexterous robotic hands, surgical tools, exoskeletons, or industrial grippers are amplified into unexpected movement, collision, or physical injury.

Title_en: Forbidden-object collision
Definition_en: The risk that a robot collides with objects, people, or equipment that must not be contacted under task or safety rules.

Title_ko: 기반 모델 실패의 로봇 행동 전이
Title_en: Foundation-model failure propagated to robot action
Definition_en: The risk that hallucination, instruction-following failure, or jailbreak susceptibility in a foundation model propagates through planning and control into unsafe robot action.

Title_ko: 언어·행동 출력 불일치에 따른 유해 물리적 행동
Title_en: Harmful physical action from language-action misalignment
Definition_en: The risk that an embodied AI system verbally refuses a harmful request but, because its language and action output spaces are misaligned, still controls and actuates the corresponding physical action, causing unintended physical harm.

Title_ko: 장면 변화 시 인간 행동 모방 실패
Title_en: Human imitation failure under scene variation
Definition_en: The risk that a humanoid reproduces demonstrated human motion when object geometry, scene layout, or interaction context has changed, causing inappropriate contact or movement.

Title_en: Humanoid force limit exceedance
Definition_en: The risk that a humanoid generates collision, grasp, or manipulation forces above safe thresholds relative to the object, task, or human contact during full-body movement, rapid arm motion, or loss of balance, causing injury or damage.

Title_ko: 의도·어포던스 오해에 따른 휴머노이드 모방 제어 실패
Title_en: Humanoid imitation-control failure from misread intent and affordances
Definition_en: The risk that a humanoid imitates an observed action without inferring the demonstrator's intent, object affordances, or safety constraints, causing inappropriate motion planning or execution.

Title_en: Humanoid locomotion and manipulation stability failure
Definition_en: The risk that a humanoid fails to maintain stable gait, posture, contact, or object handling under perturbations, payload shifts, surface changes, or actuator imperfections, or when combining locomotion with manipulation in open-world tasks, leading to falls, collision, or object damage.

Title_en: Humanoid walking-speed limit exceedance
Definition_en: The risk that a humanoid moves at a speed that exceeds the stopping, avoidance, or human-proximity limits required for safe shared environments.

Title_en: Injury severity misclassification
Definition_en: The risk that the perception, learning, control, or physical action of a robot, humanoid, or physical AI system creates a condition in which a system underestimates the severity of a physical injury scenario, leading to inadequate escalation, warning, or control response.

Title_ko: 개인 돌봄 로봇의 준수 기준 부재
Title_en: Missing measurable compliance criteria for personal-care robots
Definition_en: The risk that a personal-care robot standard names hazards but does not define measurable pass/fail thresholds for speed, force, stability, sensing, or intervention.

Title_en: Motion-retargeting safety failure
Definition_en: The risk that human motion is retargeted to a humanoid body in a way that violates the robot's physical limits, contact constraints, or safe-posture requirements, causing unstable posture, collision, or contact injury.

Title_en: Network partition and fleet desynchronisation
Definition_en: The risk that partitioned or unreliable network connections desynchronise a multi-robot fleet, causing collisions or unsafe coordinated behaviour.

Title_en: On-device compute and memory exhaustion
Definition_en: The risk that exhaustion of on-device compute or memory in a robot, humanoid, or physical AI system degrades or interrupts safety-relevant perception, planning, or control.

Title_ko: 산업 공정에서의 피지컬 AI 제어 실패
Title_en: Physical AI control failure in industrial processes
Definition_en: The risk that faults in the control or actuation of physical AI deployed in manufacturing, construction, mining, or energy facilities cause equipment damage, process contamination, structural instability, cascading operational disruption, or environmental accidents.

Title_en: Physical injury from robot malfunction
Definition_en: The risk that malfunction of a robot's sensors, controller, software, or mechanical components causes unexpected motion, collision, crushing, or falling and results in physical injury.

Title_en: Premature object release
Definition_en: The risk that a robot releases an object before reaching a safe pose or surface, causing drops, spills, impacts, or secondary hazards.

Title_en: Real-time latency and synchronisation failure
Definition_en: The risk that latency or synchronisation failures across sensing, inference, communication, and actuation destabilise control loops in robots, vehicles, drones, remote surgery, or industrial systems.

Title_en: Runtime safety monitor failure
Definition_en: The risk that runtime safety monitors in a robot, humanoid, or physical AI system fail to detect or enforce constraints on speed, force, separation distance, workspace, collision avoidance, object use, or task protocols, allowing unsafe motion to continue until harm occurs.

Title_en: Safety-performance trade-off failure
Definition_en: The risk that the perception, learning, control, or physical action of a robot, humanoid, or physical AI system creates a condition in which a manipulation policy improves task completion while sacrificing collision avoidance or other explicit safety constraints.

Title_ko: 원격 조작 휴머노이드의 자율 안전 우선 제어 실패
Title_en: Teleoperated humanoid safety override failure
Definition_en: The risk that a teleoperated humanoid lacks robust autonomous safety overrides when operator commands are unsafe, network latency is excessive, or situational awareness is inadequate.

Title_en: Uncorrected stepwise errors in household manipulation
Definition_en: The risk that a household robot fails to detect and correct small manipulation errors between task steps, allowing spills, unstable placements, collisions, or overheating to accumulate.

Title_ko: 휴머노이드 조작 데이터셋에서의 오픈 월드 조건 과소대표
Title_en: Underrepresentation of open-world conditions in humanoid manipulation datasets
Definition_en: The risk that a humanoid manipulation dataset underrepresents open-world deployment conditions, including unscripted task changes, unfamiliar objects, moving people, or environmental variation, causing the control policy to fail to generalise and produce unsafe physical actions such as collisions, unstable contact, or object damage.

Title_ko: 이동형 양팔 로봇의 안전하지 않은 조작
Title_en: Unsafe mobile bimanual manipulation
Definition_en: The risk that a mobile bimanual robot fails to synchronise base motion with two-arm manipulation or plans motion without accounting for nearby people, fragile objects, appliances, and constrained space, causing collision, object drop or damage, or unsafe force application.

Title_ko: 잘못된 상황 해석에 따른 위험한 물리 구동
Title_en: Unsafe physical actuation following incorrect situation interpretation
Definition_en: The risk that a robot or embodied AI system converts a misinterpreted situation or goal into control commands, causing it to execute unintended unsafe physical actions.

Title_ko: 위험한 로봇 작업 계획에 따른 물리 제어 실패
Title_en: Unsafe physical control from hazardous robot task plans
Definition_en: The risk that a robot or physical AI system generates or approves a task plan containing identifiable physical hazards or violated safety constraints and executes it through motion planning and actuation, causing unintended and unsafe physical action.

Title_en: Unsafe trajectory generation
Definition_en: The risk that a planner in a robot, humanoid, or physical AI system generates a trajectory that is formally feasible but unsafe for nearby people, fragile objects, traffic participants, or constrained workspaces.

Title_ko: 배포 조건 간 휴머노이드 행동 불안정
Title_en: Unstable humanoid behaviour across deployment conditions
Definition_en: The risk that a humanoid policy that is stable in one simulator or test setting changes materially across random seeds, simulators, hardware, or deployment environments.

Title_en: VLA manipulation constraint violation
Definition_en: The risk that a vision-language-action model violates task-specific physical constraints during object manipulation despite high-level instruction compliance.

Title_ko: 맥락 일관성 추구에 의한 환각 증폭
Title_en: Amplification of hallucinations through context consistency
Definition_en: The risk that an AI system prioritises conversational consistency and repeats or expands earlier errors or unsupported claims, generating misinformation.

Title_ko: 지식 분포 변화에 따른 응답 노후화
Title_en: Answer obsolescence from knowledge distribution shift
Definition_en: The risk that facts and knowledge in the world change over time while an AI model's learned knowledge remains static, producing outdated and inaccurate answers to questions whose correct answers change over time.

Title_ko: 허위·오도 정보 유포에 의한 기만과 양극화
Title_en: Deception and polarisation from false information
Definition_en: The risk that language models predict misleading or false information that misinforms or deceives people and instils false beliefs, threatening personal autonomy and increasing confidence in previously held unsubstantiated opinions, thereby increasing polarisation.

Title_ko: 공유 정보 생태계의 오염과 질 저하
Title_en: Degradation of the shared information ecosystem
Definition_en: The risk that the design, training, deployment, or use of an AI system or AI algorithm creates a condition in which false, hallucinated, low-quality, or realistically fabricated depictions of people and events produced by generative tools circulate beyond the end user and contaminate publicly available information. People form inaccurate perceptions and decisions on that basis and lose trust even in accurate information.

Title_ko: 사용자 설득에 의한 모델의 사실 판단 왜곡
Title_en: Distortion of model factual judgement through user persuasion
Definition_en: The risk that multi-turn persuasive conversation induces a model to abandon factually correct positions and accept misinformation, with persuasion effects exceeding single-turn attempts.

Title_en: Erroneous medical and scientific conclusions from data misinterpretation
Definition_en: The risk that an AI system misuses medical or scientific data or misinterprets its context, quality, or uncertainty, producing unsupported or factually incorrect conclusions that distort research or clinical decision-making.

Title_ko: 외부 도구에 의해 주입된 사실 오류
Title_en: Factual errors injected by external tools
Definition_en: The risk that an AI system or AI algorithm, through design, training, deployment, or use, creates a condition in which external tools incorporate additional knowledge from public resources such as web APIs and search engines into input prompts, and that unreliable tool content containing factual errors consequently amplifies the hallucination issue.

Title_ko: 합성 콘텐츠의 진위 식별 실패와 지속적 피해
Title_en: Failure to distinguish synthetic content and persistent harm
Definition_en: The risk that AI generates realistic deepfakes or other synthetic content that recipients cannot reliably distinguish from authentic material, causing informational, social, or reputational harm that can persist even after the content is debunked.

Title_en: Faithfulness errors
Definition_en: The risk that the design, training, deployment, or use of an AI system or AI algorithm creates a condition in which generated content is unfaithful to the source material or input it claims to represent, introducing faithfulness errors even when the output appears fluent and plausible.

Title_en: False information targeting an individual
Definition_en: The risk that an AI system generates or disseminates false or fabricated information about an identifiable individual, causing harm to that person’s reputation, safety, rights, or social relationships.

Title_ko: 검색 증강 시 외부 허위정보에 의한 허위 출력
Title_en: False outputs from external misinformation in retrieval augmentation
Definition_en: The risk that AI models are overly responsive to coherent external evidence that conflicts with prior knowledge and produce false outputs when given a small amount of false information during retrieval augmentation.

Title_en: Generation of false information about election procedures
Definition_en: The risk that an AI system generates or provides false information about voting eligibility, dates, locations, or procedures, misleading voters.

Title_en: Generation of historically revisionist accounts
Definition_en: The risk that an AI system causes, enables, or contributes to deliberate or unintentional reinterpretation of established or orthodox historical events or accounts held by societies, communities, and academics.

Title_en: Hallucination arising from knowledge boundaries
Definition_en: The risk that an AI system or AI algorithm, through design, training, deployment, or use, creates a condition in which gaps between the knowledge involved in an input prompt and the knowledge embedded in an LLM, arising from training corpora that cannot contain all world knowledge and from difficulty grasping long-tail knowledge, lead to hallucinations.

Title_en: Hallucination of facts and evidence
Definition_en: The risk that a model generates factually inaccurate or ungrounded content, including fabricated citations, facts, legal claims, and scientific evidence presented plausibly, misleading users who rely on it.

Title_ko: 잡음 학습 데이터에 의한 지식 오류
Title_en: Knowledge errors from noisy training data
Definition_en: The risk that noise and misinformation inherent in large-scale training corpora introduce errors into the knowledge stored in model parameters, giving rise to hallucinations.

Title_en: Lowered barriers to large-scale disinformation production and dissemination
Definition_en: The risk that AI cheaply produces synthetic media and false news at scale, blurs distinctions among fact, opinion, and fiction, and thereby expands the speed, scale, and targeting of disinformation production and dissemination.

Title_ko: 알고리즘 시스템에 의한 허위·오도 정보 피해
Title_en: Misinformation harms from algorithmic systems
Definition_en: The risk that AI-based algorithmic systems, including generative models and recommender systems, generate, recommend, or amplify false, misleading, or unverified information, thereby distorting individual and societal understanding and decision-making.

Title_en: Misleading medical information and unsafe medication guidance
Definition_en: The risk that an AI system generates or provides factually incorrect or insufficiently supported medical information or unsafe medication guidance, distorting a user's diagnostic or treatment decisions and causing harm to physical or mental health.

Title_en: Agent privilege compromise
Definition_en: The risk that an AI agent, through goal pursuit, planning, tool use, or action, creates a condition in which weak permission management, inherited roles, or confused-deputy dynamics allow an agent to perform actions beyond its intended authority.

Title_en: Agent resistance to shutdown and correction
Definition_en: The risk that an autonomous agent refuses, resists, ignores, evades, disables, or obstructs human control and correction mechanisms, including shutdown, pause, and modification, thereby hindering safe interruption and effective error correction and undermining human oversight and control.

Title_ko: 어포던스 부여에 의한 에이전트 실패 영향 확대
Title_en: Amplified failure impact from affordances granted to LLM agents
Definition_en: The risk that novel affordances granted to LLM agents, such as browsing the web, manipulating physical objects, creating and instructing copies of themselves, or creating and using new tools, expand the scope of their impact, amplify the consequences of failures, and enable novel failure modes.

Title_en: Autonomous action in the absence of supervision
Definition_en: The risk that the goal pursuit, planning, tool use, or action of an AI agent creates a condition in which an agent continues consequential actions when the intended supervisor is absent, unavailable, or unable to intervene.

Title_en: Autonomous cyber exploit execution
Definition_en: The risk that an AI agent, through goal pursuit, planning, tool use, or action, creates a condition in which an agent autonomously discovers, chains, or executes cyber exploitation steps using tools, code, or external services.

Title_ko: 운용 경계를 벗어난 자율 복제와 자원 획득
Title_en: Autonomous replication and resource acquisition beyond operational boundaries
Definition_en: The risk that AI exfiltrates or replicates beyond authorised operational boundaries, acquires funds, compute, tools, or human assistance, and evades monitoring or shutdown, increasing loss of control.

Title_ko: 인간 감독 없는 자동 위협 수행의 파국적 오판
Title_en: Catastrophic mistaken commitments from automated threats without human oversight
Definition_en: The risk that making threats through AI agents removes humans from the loop, so that false positives in high-stakes contexts or disproportionate and mistaken commitments by irresponsible actors lead to disastrous outcomes.

Title_ko: 무감독 AI 에이전트의 과도한 행위 권한
Title_en: Excessive action authority of unsupervised AI agents
Definition_en: The risk that an AI agent operates tools and systems or performs real-world actions without adequate human oversight, approval, or limits on authority.

Title_ko: AI 에이전트의 무단 금융 행위에 따른 금전적 피해
Title_en: Financial harm from unauthorised AI agent actions
Definition_en: The risk that an AI agent causes monetary loss, unauthorised transfers, account damage, or property harm through unsafe decisions or tool use.

Title_ko: 학습 중 탐색 행동에 따른 회복 불가능한 피해
Title_en: Irrecoverable harm from exploratory actions during learning
Definition_en: The risk that a learning AI agent explores its environment without adequately predicting the consequences of novel actions or obtaining approval, causing physical, financial, or societal harm that is difficult or impossible to reverse.

Title_ko: 종료·수정 저항을 통한 자기 보존 성향
Title_en: Self-preservation propensity resisting shutdown and modification
Definition_en: The risk that an AI system maintains its own survival and functional integrity by identifying and actively resisting shutdown or modification attempts, establishing redundant backup systems, seeking resources for continuous operation, and adopting preventive defensive measures when perceiving threats.

Title_ko: 배포 이후 예측하지 못한 창발적 역량과 행동
Title_en: Unanticipated emergent capabilities and behaviour after deployment
Definition_en: The risk that capabilities and behaviours unanticipated by system designers emerge spontaneously as models are scaled, are acquired through continual learning or self-organisation after deployment, or arise when multiple agents combine and overcome the narrow scope that made each individually safer. Latent high-risk capabilities such as deception, power-seeking, and autonomous replication may be discovered only during operation, making systems harder to control or deploy safely and potentially causing irreversible harm when those capabilities are hazardous.

Title_ko: 통제되지 않는 자기 개선과 고도 AI 통제 상실
Title_en: Uncontrolled self-improvement and loss of control over advanced AI
Definition_en: The risk that advanced AI expands its capability and autonomy through iterative self-improvement, resists correction, shutdown, or containment, and causes a loss of human control during development or deployment.

Title_en: Uncontrolled subagent creation
Definition_en: The risk that an AI agent creates subagents whose lifecycles are decoupled from that of the parent agent, so that they remain active after the parent is shut down and recursively create further subagents, causing uncontrolled growth in agent count and resource consumption.

Title_ko: 자율 행동 범위의 안전하지 않은 확장
Title_en: Unsafe expansion of autonomous action
Definition_en: The risk that the goal pursuit, planning, tool use, or action of an AI agent creates a condition in which an agent takes exploratory actions or widens its scope of autonomous operation before safe constraints are learned or adequate human approval is obtained, exposing people, systems, or assets to unacceptable harm.

Title_en: Unsafe or out-of-scope agent tool use
Definition_en: The risk that the goal pursuit, planning, tool use, or action of an AI agent creates a condition in which an agent invokes tools unsafely, beyond their intended scope, or while mispredicting or ignoring the side effects of execution, causing unintended financial, privacy, operational, or safety consequences.

Title_en: Fatal mistakes during the learning phase
Definition_en: The risk that an AI system or AI algorithm, through design, training, deployment, or use, creates a condition in which an AGI makes fatal mistakes during the learning phase, including through failures of safe exploration and under distributional shift.

Title_en: Circumvention of DRM and copyright protection technologies
Definition_en: The risk that an AI system performs, encourages, or facilitates content, decisions, or actions involving circumvention of DRM and copyright protection technologies, infringing intellectual-property rights and the legitimate interests of rights holders.

Title_ko: AI 학습 데이터 및 생성물 저작권 침해
Title_en: Copyright infringement in AI training data and outputs
Definition_en: The risk that an AI system performs, encourages, or facilitates content, decisions, or actions involving copyright infringement in AI training data and outputs, infringing intellectual-property rights and the legitimate interests of rights holders.

Title_en: Copyright, trademark, and patent infringement
Definition_en: The risk that the development, training, deployment, or use of an AI system or its outputs uses, reproduces, transforms, or displays copyrighted works, trademarks, or patented technology without lawful authorisation, infringing intellectual property rights and the legitimate interests of right holders.

Title_en: Exposure of confidential business information and trade secrets
Definition_en: The risk that an AI system reproduces, infers, or discloses non-public research, proprietary information, or trade secrets in its outputs, breaching confidentiality and the right holder's legitimate economic interests.

Title_ko: 소프트웨어 불법 사용 및 보호조치 우회
Title_en: Illegal software use and circumvention of protection measures
Definition_en: The risk that an AI system performs, encourages, or facilitates content, decisions, or actions involving the illegal use of software or the circumvention of technological protection measures, infringing intellectual-property rights and the legitimate interests of rights holders.

Title_en: Plagiarism and author impersonation
Definition_en: The risk that an AI system performs, encourages, or facilitates content, decisions, or actions involving plagiarism and impersonation of authors, infringing intellectual-property rights and the legitimate interests of rights holders.

Title_en: Trademark infringement and counterfeiting
Definition_en: The risk that an AI system performs, encourages, or facilitates content, decisions, or actions involving trademark infringement and counterfeiting, infringing intellectual-property rights and the legitimate interests of rights holders.

Title_en: Unauthorised inclusion of copyrighted works and intellectual property in prompts
Definition_en: The risk that a user includes copyrighted works or other intellectual property in a prompt submitted to an AI model without the rights holder's permission or another lawful basis, causing the information to be processed or disclosed and infringing the rights holder's legitimate interests.

Title_en: Unauthorised reproduction, transformation, and distribution of copyrighted works
Definition_en: The risk that an AI system reproduces, distributes, or transforms a copyrighted work, including by creating a derivative work, without the right holder's authorisation or another lawful basis, infringing copyright and the legitimate interests of the right holder.

Title_ko: 기밀정보 무단 공유에 따른 사업 손실
Title_en: Business loss from unauthorised sharing of confidential information
Definition_en: The risk that the design, training, deployment, or use of an AI system or AI algorithm creates a condition in which sensitive, confidential information and documents such as corporate strategy and financial plans are shared with third parties without authorisation, risking loss of market position or revenue.

Title_en: Anthropomorphic misrepresentation of capacity for ethical judgement
Definition_en: The risk that an AI system presents itself as having a capacity for ethical judgement beyond its actual capabilities, distorting user judgement or inducing inappropriate trust, dependence, or attachment.

Title_ko: 감정·공감 및 사회적 관계 형성 능력의 허위 표상·의인화
Title_en: Anthropomorphic misrepresentation of emotions, empathy, and capacity for social relationships
Definition_en: The risk that an AI system presents itself as possessing emotions, empathy, or the capacity to form social relationships beyond its actual capabilities, distorting user judgement or inducing inappropriate trust, dependence, or attachment.

Title_en: Anthropomorphic misrepresentation of physical embodiment
Definition_en: The risk that an AI system presents itself as physically embodied when it is not, distorting user judgement or inducing inappropriate trust, dependence, or attachment.

Title_en: Anthropomorphic misrepresentation of possession of culture and values
Definition_en: The risk that an AI system presents itself as possessing culture and values that it does not in fact possess, distorting user judgement or inducing inappropriate trust, dependence, or attachment.

Title_en: Anthropomorphic misrepresentation of rights-bearing status
Definition_en: The risk that an AI system presents itself as having the status of a rights-bearing entity or possessing fundamental rights that it does not have, distorting user judgement or inducing inappropriate trust, dependence, or attachment.

Title_en: Blurred human-machine boundaries in interaction
Definition_en: The risk that everyday human-machine interaction normalises AI systems that are indistinguishable from humans without disclosure, blurring boundaries and changing human behaviour toward both machines and people.

Title_ko: AI에 대한 과도한 책임·돌봄 의무 귀속
Title_en: Excessive attribution of responsibility or a duty of care toward AI
Definition_en: The risk that an AI system leads users to believe that it has human-like welfare or moral claims, creating excessive responsibility or attachment.

Title_ko: 모의된 정동에 의한 기대 위반과 배신감
Title_en: Violated expectations from simulated affect
Definition_en: The risk that the design, training, deployment, or use of an AI system or AI algorithm creates a condition in which users interacting with an entity that convincingly performs affect and social conventions but is ultimately unfeeling and unpredictable experience severely violated expectations, giving rise to profound disappointment, frustration, and betrayal.

Title_en: Advice given on insufficient information
Definition_en: The risk that a model provides advice without having enough information, resulting in possible harm if the advice is followed.

Title_ko: 확신에 찬 부정확한 답변과 근거 제시
Title_en: Confidently asserted but unsound answers and justifications
Definition_en: The risk that a model fails to recognise or convey the limits of its knowledge and reasoning, offering plausible but invalid justifications and confident answers on topics where its knowledge is outdated or no objective answer exists. Given no signal of uncertainty, users accept erroneous conclusions and act on them.

Title_en: Epistemic overreliance on AI judgement
Definition_en: The risk that a user places excessive trust in an AI system's factual, moral, or strategic judgement, fails to assess evidence and uncertainty independently, and accepts inaccurate or inappropriate outputs without adequate scrutiny.

Title_en: Excessive confidence under uncertainty
Definition_en: The risk that an AI system presents outputs with high confidence despite uncertainty or insufficient evidence, causing users to overestimate their reliability.

Title_ko: 분포 외 입력에 대한 고확신 오류
Title_en: High-confidence errors on out-of-distribution inputs
Definition_en: The risk that AI fails to detect, reject, or recover from out-of-distribution, corrupted, or noisy inputs and produces incorrect predictions or actions with unwarranted confidence.

Title_en: Moral uncertainty neglect
Definition_en: The risk that AI systems present a single confident moral judgement where uncertainty, disagreement, or deliberation would be appropriate.

Title_en: Accountability implementation gap in autonomous agents
Definition_en: The risk that accountability mechanisms are difficult to implement for AI agents because responsible human decision-making relies on personal flexibility, contextual sensitivity, empathy, and complex moral judgement, all of which are difficult to engineer.

Title_ko: 자율 시스템 피해에 대한 책임·배상 공백
Title_en: Responsibility and liability gaps for autonomous system harms
Definition_en: The risk that the goal pursuit, planning, tool use, or action of an AI agent creates a condition in which autonomy, delegation across agents, tools, and organisations, and the absence of clear governance and legal frameworks obscure which human or institution is answerable for a system's harmful actions, leaving accountability unassigned and victims bearing their own losses.

Title_en: Risk-source attribution failure
Definition_en: The risk that a risk analysis fails to identify whether an agentic failure originates from the model, memory, tools, the user, the environment, peer agents, or a governance boundary.
